description: This Java class 'ProductImageCropUtils' provides utilities for cropping images, including determining crop feasibility, calculating crop areas, and generating cropped images.

classes.name: ProductImageCropUtils
classes.description: A utility class for cropping images, including methods to determine cropability, calculate crop areas, and generate cropped images.

methods.name: ProductImageCropUtils
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cropping utility with an image and target dimensions, determining crop feasibility and area.

methods.name: determineCropeable
methods.description: Determines if the image can be cropped based on its dimensions and target specifications.

methods.name: determineCropArea
methods.description: Calculates the crop area dimensions based on the original image size and target specifications.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a cropped version of the original image as a File, given crop coordinates and dimensions.

methods.name: getCroppedImage
methods.description: Returns a BufferedImage of the cropped area of the original image.

methods.name: getCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the crop area.

methods.name: setCropAreaWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the crop area.

methods.name: getCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the crop area.

methods.name: setCropAreaHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the crop area.

methods.name: setCropeable
methods.description: Sets whether the image is croppable.

methods.name: isCropeable
methods.description: Returns whether the image is croppable.
